en: In chapter 16, what does Job bitterly call his three friends?
In chapter 17, Job says whoever has clean what grows stronger?
In chapter 17, what kind of man can Job not find among his friends?
In chapter 19, Job says that in his flesh he will see whom?
In chapter 21, Job compares the wicked blown by the wind to what?
In chapter 22, Eliphaz says God is hidden by what thick covering?
In chapter 23, what would Job fill when pleading his case before God?
In chapter 25, Bildad compares man to which lowly creature?
In chapter 25, Bildad asks on whom God's what does not rise?
Which sound of God's power can no one understand, says Job in chapter 26?
In chapter 27, who will not weep for the wicked man's dead?
In chapter 28, besides the deep, what says wisdom is not with it?
